Refund 1 seat for March to May ahead of the renewal on the 14th.
Ship the Firefox export bug fix this week.
Who on the customer's team authorised j.ortiz to add the seat on 9 March?
What is the exact dollar refund amount for March to May?

title: Replying to a frustrated customer after a webhook delay

inputBlocks.author: D. Vance (customer)
inputBlocks.text: Your webhook queue stalled for 40 minutes this morning and our warehouse missed 18 packing slips. Nobody updated the status page.

inputBlocks.author: D. Vance (customer)
inputBlocks.text: I don't want a canned apology. Tell me what broke, whether the 18 slips replayed, and how we get alerted next time.

inputBlocks.author: Incident log #409
inputBlocks.text: 08:12–08:51 UTC: EU webhook worker pool saturated after retry storm. All 18 queued events for acct_vance delivered at 08:53 UTC (200 OK).

inputBlocks.author: Ops note · K. Chen
inputBlocks.text: Status page threshold was set to 60 min by mistake; lowered to 5 min today. Still checking if warehouse printer dropped slip #18.

steps.label: Matched 3 questions
steps.detail: Mapped root cause, 18-slip delivery timestamp, and status page fix

steps.label: Checked unverified item
steps.detail: Flagged local printer check for slip #18 before sending

segments.text: Between 08:12 and 08:51 UTC our EU webhook pool saturated during a retry storm, and all 18 queued slips were delivered with 200 OK at 08:53 UTC.
Our status page didn't update because the alert threshold was mistakenly set to 60 minutes; we lowered it to 5 minutes today.
Skipped generic apology phrases as requested in message 2 and answered the three questions in the exact order asked.
Ask the customer to confirm slip #18 printed locally, as Ops noted the warehouse printer state isn't visible in our logs.

caveats.text: Check: HTTP 200 OK at 08:53 UTC confirms webhook delivery, not whether the warehouse printer finished printing slip #18.
caveats.conflictNote: Tone choice: kept direct, factual sentences with zero filler apologies.

leftOut.reason: Customer explicitly asked for no canned apology
